🧭 How to explore

Walk around the area and approach characters or creatures to interact with them.

Talk to the local guide first. Then visit the blacksmith, learn kanji, and challenge the monsters. Spend gold in the blacksmith’s 🛒 shop. Battles and gathering earn practice points toward Learning and Familiar (capped each hour of play). Formal Journal reviews are needed for Mastered, and they can also decay kanji.

⌨️ Keyboard: use the arrow keys or WASD to move. On a phone or tablet, use the direction pad.
